caption:
A US cardiologist still runs free medical camps in the Jharkhand village he grew up in. He's held over 150 of them.

Dr. Avinash Gupta, born in Karum village in Ranchi, Jharkhand, arrived in the US in 1986 and has practiced cardiology in Lakewood, New Jersey since 1994. Through PRAN-BJANA, he has led over 150 free medical camps in rural Bihar and Jharkhand, and during COVID-19 organized vaccination drives and telemedicine for Indian-Americans in New Jersey. He later served as President of the Federation of Indian Associations and Regional Director of the American Association of Physicians of Indian Origin.

He built a cardiology practice in New Jersey. He never stopped practicing medicine in the village he left.

Sources: The Indian Panorama, NJB Magazine (1986-2026)
